help: Saved answers stay in this field. They must match the new type and validation rule. Existing customer profiles are not changed.
checkingHelp: Large forms may take a few seconds. You can keep editing or cancel.
compatible: All {{count}} saved answers are compatible. They will be checked again when you save.
empty: No saved answers to check. The new type will apply when you save.
incompatible: {{invalid}} of {{total}} saved answers do not match the new type or validation rule.
blockedHelp: Review the answers or choose another type. No answers have been changed.
reviewHelp: Scroll to see more answers, or search for a value. Open a submission to see the full answer.
noMatches: No incompatible answers match your search.
typeMismatch: Does not match the field type
ruleMismatch: Does not match the validation rule
loadMoreFailed: Could not load more answers. Your loaded answers are still here.
unavailable: Could not check saved answers. Try again before confirming the conversion.
timeout: The check exceeded its time limit. No fields were changed. Simplify a custom rule or try again when the server is less busy.
invalidValidator: The validation pattern is invalid or too long. Update it before converting.
stale: This field changed since you opened the form. Reopen the form before converting it.
missing: This field no longer exists. Reopen the form to load the latest fields.
unsupported: These field types cannot be converted without changing the saved answers.
linked: Linked custom fields cannot be converted.
duplicate: This customer field is already used in the form. Choose another field.
logics: Update the conditional rules that use this field before converting it.
changedAnswers: Saved answers for “{{fieldName}}” are incompatible. Return to the field editor to review them. No fields were changed.
transactionsRequired: Field conversion is not available on this database setup. Ask your administrator to enable MongoDB transactions. Your draft has been kept.
formChanged: The form changed or is receiving submissions. Try saving again. Your draft has been kept and no changes were saved.
